feedback.delta: Adaptive semantic resolution now extends to retrieval planning itself: 0/1/2-hop and exact/direct/graph routing should be budgeted by query causal need; hard ancestry deletion is a negative result.
Add/test non-authoritative AssemblyPlanner in M.MEMORY_FABRIC; preserve CognitiveFrame, durable exact state and capability authority.
Represent AssemblyPlan/AssemblyCertificate semantics, evidence-family lineage and exact-anchor requirement without letting model-proposed plan mint authority.
Dynamic topology should include query-conditioned active traversal topology distinct from semantic dependency and physical locality; erroneous-edge stress favors relevance-gated expansion in proxy.
Memory assembly selection must be factorially separated from GWT selection: truthful G1b vs graph-relation-shuffled vs temporal-shuffled assembly at matched content budget.
No emergence promotion. Better retrieval/error robustness is functional memory evidence only; lesion/rescue/OOD/multiscale certificate remains unchanged.
G1b supersedes G1 only as the preferred HOLD candidate for next benchmark; accepted graph remains generation 0. Query planning, relevance-gated expansion and soft ancestry control are added.

evidence_ancestry: Cycle2 local experiments are one designed-proxy family; external papers/issues are separate source classes but do not count as ClayGraph replication.
